'''Misha Quor-Din''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who served the the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], Misha Quor-Din became a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] at the experimental [[Almas Academy|Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]]. Under the guidance of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and [[Mistress of Lightsabers|Academy battlemaster]] [[Kirlocca]], Quor-Din and a group of other students went on an expedition into the [[Almas Wasteland]] in [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]]. However, some of the Jedi fell under the influence of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and attacked Kirlocca. Quor-Din and the rest of the Jedi tried to defend Kirlocca, but were driven back by their deranged opponents. However, while she fled, she was captured by a group of [[Believers]].<ref name="ADF" />

She was taken back to the [[Almas Sith fortress]], where she was made the prisoner of [[Garvin Delquist]], a researcher at the [[Forard research station]] who had been given dark side powers by a [[Sith talisman/Legends|Sith amulet]]. He had fallen in love with Quor-Din, which was why he had ordered her capture, but she did not reciprocate his feelings and rejected his advances. She was eventually rescued by a group of agents sent by Master [[Lanius Qel-Bertuk]] and returned to the Academy unharmed.<ref name="ADF" />
